verses.text: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know the Lord: his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain unto the earth.
verses.plain: Let us press on to know the Lord. As surely as the sun rises, he will appear; he will come to us like the winter rains, like the spring rains that water the earth.

verses.text: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
verses.plain: For I desire mercy, not sacrifice, and the knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings.
